title: Jackal command (controller -> sim), protocol v1
description: v/w outside [-V_MAX, V_MAX] / [-W_MAX, W_MAX] are valid and get CLAMPED, not dropped. Non-finite numbers are invalid. Extra fields are allowed so minor versions stay backward compatible.

v.description: Forward speed, m/s, body x. Positive = forward.

w.description: Yaw rate, rad/s, body z. Positive = counter-clockwise (left).

estop.description: Latched stop until a reset message or the UI button.

action.description: Discrete event, e.g. "horn", "mark", "mode:<name>". Logged and shown in the HUD.

source.description: Free-form sender id, shown in the HUD and logged.

seq.description: Sender sequence number (lets the sim count drops).

t.description: Sender clock, seconds. Echoed back in state.cmd_echo_t.
